title: Pure Adventure
summary: The pure Adventurer Token party build with generic staples. Every monster, Equip Spell, Field Spell and Trap in the archetype revolves around keeping an Adventurer Token on the field via Rite of Aramesir and outfitting it with Equip Spells.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rite of Aramesir Special Summons an Adventurer Token (Fairy/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) and places Fateful Adventure face-up from the Deck, with the restriction that you cannot activate the effects of Normal Summoned monsters that turn.
Water Enchantress of the Temple banishes itself from the hand or GY to add Rite of Aramesir from the Deck or GY to your hand.
Foolish Burial dumps Water Enchantress of the Temple directly to the GY, acting as an extra copy of Rite of Aramesir.

summary.title: Opening: Water Enchantress or Rite of Aramesir
steps: Banish Water Enchantress of the Temple from the hand or GY to search Rite of Aramesir.
Activate Rite of Aramesir to summon an Adventurer Token and place Fateful Adventure from the Deck.

Use Fateful Adventure to search Wandering Gryphon Rider or Illegal Knight and discard a card; if you discard Dracoback, Dunnell or Starlit Papillon, it immediately equips itself to the Adventurer Token.
Special Summon Wandering Gryphon Rider or Celestial Apparatus Tesea from the hand, triggering Fateful Adventure to equip another Equip Spell from the Deck to the Adventurer Token.

summary.title: The Party Members
points: Wandering Gryphon Rider Special Summons itself on either turn while you control an Adventurer Token, and shuffles itself into the Deck to negate any card or effect activation.
Illegal Knight Special Summons itself and can hand control of itself to the opponent as a Quick Effect to return up to two other cards they control to the hand.
Celestial Apparatus Tesea Special Summons itself while you control an Adventurer Token and reveals a card mentioning Adventurer Token to search a non-Normal Spell mentioning it.
Magicore Warrior of the Relics Special Summons itself alongside the Token and Sets Breath of Resurrection or Thunder Discharge from the Deck at the end of the Battle Phase after your monster battles.

summary.title: Equips, Field Spells & Traps
points: Dracoback, the Rideable Dragon, Dunnell, the Noble Arms of Light and Starlit Papillon all re-equip themselves to the Adventurer Token when sent to the GY, letting you pay discard costs for Fateful Adventure for free.

Dracoback bounces an opposing card while equipped to a non-Effect Monster (the Adventurer Token), Dunnell grants 500 ATK per Adventurer monster you control, and Starlit Papillon weakens every opposing monster.

Forest of Lost Flowers and Zaralaam the Dark Palace (searchable by Terraforming or Water Enchantress on the field) protect the Token equipped with Starlit Papillon or lock out opposing activations during attacks when Dunnell is equipped.

Thunder Discharge wipes all opposing monsters whose ATK is lower than your equipped Adventurer Token, and Breath of Resurrection revives party members while equipping an Equip Spell from the hand or GY.

allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Water Enchantress of the Temple directly to the GY to search Rite of Aramesir.
allow.Terraforming: Searches Forest of Lost Flowers or Zaralaam the Dark Palace.

main: Water Enchantress of the Temple
Banishes itself from hand or GY to add Rite of Aramesir from Deck or GY.
Wandering Gryphon Rider
Special Summons itself when you control an Adventurer Token; shuffles itself into the Deck for an omni-negate.
Illegal Knight
Special Summons itself and gives control to the opponent to bounce up to 2 cards they control.
Magicore Warrior of the Relics
Special Summons itself with an Adventurer Token on field; sets a Trap that mentions Adventurer Token upon battle.
Celestial Apparatus Tesea
Special Summons itself when you control an Adventurer Token and searches a Spell/Trap mentioning Adventurer Token.
Rite of Aramesir
Summons an Adventurer Token and places Fateful Adventure face-up from the Deck.
Fateful Adventure
Searches any monster that mentions Adventurer Token and equips an Equip Spell from Deck upon summon.
Dracoback, the Rideable Dragon
Re-equips itself to the Adventurer Token when sent to the GY and bounces an opposing card.
Dunnell, the Noble Arms of Light
Increases ATK by 500 per monster mentioning Adventurer Token and searches when sent to the GY.
Starlit Papillon
Reduces opposing monsters' ATK and re-equips to the Adventurer Token when sent to the GY.
Zaralaam the Dark Palace
Field Spell that prevents opponent activations during Adventurer attacks and burns on destroy.
Forest of Lost Flowers
Field Spell that protects monsters equipped with Starlit Papillon and draws a card on battle destruction.
Breath of Resurrection
Trap that revives monsters and equips an Equip Spell mentioning Adventurer Token.
Thunder Discharge
Trap that destroys opposing monsters with lower ATK than your equipped Adventurer Token.
Foolish Burial
Dumps Water Enchantress of the Temple to immediately search Rite of Aramesir.
Terraforming
Searches Forest of Lost Flowers or Zaralaam the Dark Palace.
